chunks: 4810 - And in the narration of Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Kinānī:

“Zaynab said to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله: ‘You do not act justly, while you are the Messenger of Allah.’ And Ḥafṣah said: ‘If he divorces us, we will find among our people our equals from Quraysh.’ So revelation was withheld from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله for twenty-nine days. Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, showed zeal for His Messenger, so Allah revealed:”
“O Prophet, say to your wives: If you desire the life of this world and its adornment...”
“Up to His saying, ‘a great reward.’ So they chose Allah and His Messenger, and divorce did not occur. Had they chosen themselves, they would have been separated.”

key_terms.أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا: a tremendous reward prepared by Allah
key_terms.أَزْوَاجِكَ: your wives, referring to the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا: the worldly life and its immediate attractions

ai.seo_question: Why were the Prophet’s wives given a choice between worldly life and remaining with him?
ai.summary: This report connects the revelation of the verses of choice for the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم with a moment of tension in the household of the Prophet. It explains that Allah directed the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to offer them a choice between worldly life and Allah, His Messenger, and the Hereafter, and that they chose Allah and His Messenger, so separation did not take place.
